parts.label: (b)
parts.text: State two family structures.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Describe three ways family life can be positive for its members.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text: Explain three ways urbanisation affects family life.

parts.label: (e)
parts.text:
Discuss the view that family life is diverse.

parts.text:
Evaluate the view that the family benefits capitalism.
Your answer should include:
• at least three arguments for and three arguments against
• a conclusion.
